Senses.Explanation: Lightning flash and stone-struck spark name two momentary flashes. Chan verses and appraisals place the lightning-and-spark expression with responsive change, sharp encounter timing, and responses that must occur before the flash is gone. The stored witnesses support extreme brevity and quick change; they do not securely assign the whole comparison to Baizhang or state that deliberation always arrives too late.
